tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows positive short-horizon gain, while the acquired observations cross zero and become negative by H=24.2. Fit the authorized dual-exponential adaptation law numerically and test it on fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; its three observations cover the reversal and target horizon.
The observed short- and long-horizon responses identify the authorized four-parameter mechanism without another measurement.
The authorized dual-horizon law directly explains the observed reversal; no nonzero s_grad evidence indicates a sink effect.
The observed short-window response and slow reversal are consistent with the authorized adaptation mechanism, with no evidence of a periodic cycle.
